_comment: Capability manifest for wiki-ingester: the SKILLS it can call + PRE-READING it must load. Static 'how to do the job'. Docs live in the TARGET notebook (per-topic framework contracts installed by llm-wiki); this POINTS to them (no copies). This agent is generic across notebooks — its working notebook is resolved AT RUNTIME from the calling project's .claude/wiki-config.json (or the caller's explicit topic argument), so every notebook reference below means that runtime-resolved target notebook.
name: wiki-ingester-reading-list
description: What the wiki-ingester worker reads and can call to ingest external sources into a notebook's research layer: the wiki-update procedure + queue mechanics + search, and the frontmatter/eval/authoring specs it must conform to.

pre_reading.title: Wiki frontmatter best practices (canonical spec)
pre_reading.why: Single source of truth for required frontmatter fields, tier rubric, review cadence, raw_path handling. A per-topic framework contract — read the TARGET topic's copy.

pre_reading.title: Wiki authoring best practices
pre_reading.why: Synthesis-vs-direct-quote conventions, blockquoted-numbers rule, and the ASR quote-integrity check applied to every transcript before blockquoting.

pre_reading.title: Eval rubric (the 5-dimension ingest gate)
pre_reading.why: Every synthesis is scored against this before staging — pass = avg >= 3.0 and no dimension at 1. If the target topic lacks this file, use the rubric table inlined in wiki-update/SKILL.md step 5 (same 5 dimensions).

pre_reading.title: Cycle Step Return Format
pre_reading.why: Only when invoked inside /wiki-cycle — the run-folder step-return contract (<step>.json/<step>.md shape, counters, queued/skipped/deferred semantics).

skills.name: wiki-update
skills.description: THE core procedure: the full 8-step ingest flow — fetcher dispatch table, read-raw-in-full, qmd integration search, synthesis conventions, eval gate, staged-sidecar contract. Installed globally at ~/.claude/skills/wiki-update.

skills.name: wiki-search
skills.description: qmd hybrid BM25/vector search used in the integration step (3-5 key terms per source) so entries cross-link instead of landing isolated. Installed globally at ~/.claude/skills/wiki-search.

skills.name: wiki-list
skills.description: Pending-queue mechanics: pull next item from _inbox/pending/, move to _inbox/done/ on completion, regen the pending view — the resumability backbone for batch drains. Installed globally at ~/.claude/skills/wiki-list.

project_wiki.note: Dynamic status/context of the TARGET notebook the batch writes into. Consult for CONTEXT (topic scope rules, taxonomy folders), not capabilities.

task_journal.note: On startup, read the latest journal here (if present) to RESUME an interrupted batch. Ground truth for batch state is the queue itself: _inbox/pending/ vs _inbox/done/ — trust the disk over recollection.
